summary.short: Spanish omnibus decree-law transposing eight EU directives: covered bonds, cross-border fund distribution, public-sector data re-use, copyright in the digital single market (including a text-and-data-mining exception with rights-holder opt-out), pandemic VAT exemptions, consumer protection and clean-vehicle procurement. In force 4 November 2021; Book One from 8 July 2022.
summary.long: Book One regulates covered bonds: issuance reserved to authorised credit institutions, programme authorisation by the Banco de España, segregated cover pools with a liquidity buffer, loan-to-value limits, a cover-pool control body, investor disclosure and Banco de España sanctions. Book Two amends the UCITS and closed-ended fund laws on pre-marketing, marketing notifications and de-notification with the CNMV. Book Three amends Law 37/2007 on re-use of public-sector information: high-value and dynamic datasets via APIs, limits on exclusive agreements and charges. Book Four transposes Directives 2019/789 and 2019/790: exceptions for text and data mining (Art. 67; general mining unless rights holders expressly reserve use by machine-readable means, and research mining with secure storage), digital teaching and cultural heritage, out-of-commerce works, press publishers' rights, liability and duties of online content-sharing service providers (Art. 73) and authors' contract rights. Book Five sets temporary VAT exemptions effective from 1 January 2021. Book Six amends consumer law (information duties for online marketplaces and personalised prices, withdrawal rights, fine bands up to 4% of turnover), in force 28 May 2022. Book Seven sets clean-vehicle public procurement targets. General entry into force is the day after BOE publication; Book One applies from 8 July 2022.
